description: Returns a YouTube channel's totals and up to 200 of its uploads (id, title, publish date) in the channel's upload-list order. Give the handle or, without one, the channel id. Use to see which videos a channel has; it runs no checks. For the checks on one video use video_check; for how a website embeds the channel's videos use video_site.
name: video_channel
title: Check a video channel
